[RCLI.1.13] **`--help` writes the usage.** At the head of an invocation, or
directly after a subcommand, `--help` or `-h` must write the usage to standard
output and exit `0`, and the compiler reads no input. The usage's wording is not
a contract. It must not list an option this edition refuses ([RCLI.1.9]).

An invocation with no arguments parses against nothing, and is a usage error
([RCLI.3.1]).
